# Sirach Chapter 21 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 21 | **Date:** 2026-03-17

---

**21:1** My-child, have-you-sinned? Add-not again, and concerning your-former [sins] pray so-that-they-may-be-forgiven you.

**21:2** Flee from sin as-from-the-face-of a-serpent, for if you-approach it, it-will-bite you; its-teeth are-the-teeth of a-lion, slaying the-souls of-men.

**21:3** Like a-two-edged sword is all-lawlessness; its-wound has-no healing.

**21:4** Terror and violence lay-waste wealth; thus the-house of-the arrogant will-be-laid-waste.

**21:5** A-prayer from-the-mouth of a-poor-man reaches to-the ears of-God, and his-judgment comes-swiftly.

**21:6** One-who-hates reproof is in-the-track of a-sinner; but one-who-fears the-LORD will-turn-back in-his-heart.

**21:7** One-known-for-his-tongue is a-capable-man from-afar, but a-sensible-man knows when he-slips.

**21:8** One-who-builds his-house with the-money of-others is like one-who-gathers stones for his-winter-tomb.

**21:9** The-assembly of-the lawless is like tow-gathered-together, and their-end is a-flame of-fire.

**21:10** The-way of-sinners is paved-smooth with stones, but at-its-end is the-pit of-Hades.

**21:11** One-who-keeps the-law controls his-thoughts; and the-completion of-the-fear-of-the-LORD is wisdom.

**21:12** One-who-is-not-clever cannot be-educated; but there-is cleverness that-multiplies bitterness.

**21:13** The-knowledge of a-wise-man will-overflow like a-flood, and his-counsel is like a-living spring.

**21:14** The-inner-part of a-fool is like a-broken vessel, and all-wisdom he-cannot hold.

**21:15** When a-man-of-understanding hears a-wise-word, he-praises it and adds to-it; the-dissolute man hears it and-dislikes it and casts it behind his-back.

**21:16** The-utterance of a-fool is like a-burden on-a-journey, but on-the-lips of a-sensible-person grace is-found.

**21:17** The-mouth of a-sensible-person is sought-out in-the-assembly, and his-words they-ponder in-their-heart.

**21:18** Like a-house that-has-been-destroyed is wisdom to a-fool, and the-knowledge of-the-senseless is words-without-examination.

**21:19** Like-fetters-on-the-feet is instruction to a-foolish-person, and like-manacles-on-the-right-hand.

**21:20** A-fool raises his-voice in-laughter, but a-clever-man barely-smiles quietly.

**21:21** Like an-ornament-of-gold is instruction to a-sensible-person, and like a-bracelet upon his-right-arm.

**21:22** The-foot of a-fool rushes into a-house, but a-man-of-experience stands-back-in-respect before it.

**21:23** A-stupid-person peers into the-house through the-door, but a-well-trained-man stands outside.

**21:24** It-is-boorishness in a-person to-listen at-the-door, but the-discreet-person is-grieved by-the-disgrace.

**21:25** The-lips of-the-arrogant speak of-the-things-of-others, but the-words of-the-prudent are-weighed in-the-balance.

**21:26** In-the-mouth of-the-foolish is their-heart, but the-heart of-the-wise is in-their-mouth.

**21:27** When an-impious-man curses an-adversary, he-curses his-own-soul.

**21:28** A-whisperer defiles his-own-soul and is-hated everywhere he-sojourns.
